title: Perceive, Predict, and Plan: a Unified World Action Model for Egocentric Dexterous Manipulation
title_zh: 感知、预测与规划：面向自我中心灵巧操作的统一世界动作模型

paragraphs.en: 本文提出了一种面向自我中心灵巧操作的统一世界动作模型P$^{3}$-WAM。 We introduce P$^{3}$-WAM, a unified world action model for egocentric dexterous manipulation that learns 3D perception, action-conditioned prediction, and goal-directed planning through three complementary modes: Perceive, which reconstructs articulated hand motion and camera trajectories from video; Predict, which generates visual futures under prescribed actions; and Plan, which jointly generates action trajectories and their anticipated visual consequences conditioned on an initial image, a language instruction, and an optional visual goal. Our model integrates a compact, structured 3D action representation into a pretrained video diffusion transformer through a mixture-of-transformers architecture with shared base weights, modality-specific adaptation, and bidirectional visual-action attention. Randomized modality visibility lets video and 3D actions serve as either conditioning context or prediction targets across the three modes. Experiments show that unified training improves all three capabilities over single-mode training, including gains in planning quality under a vision-language model evaluation. Through unified training, our model outperforms specialized baselines on 3D hand reconstruction and action-conditioned video prediction across four datasets, while producing goal-directed manipulation videos with stronger instruction adherence and action progression than video-generation baselines. Project Page: https://p3-wam.pages.dev/
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了一种面向自我中心灵巧操作的统一世界动作模型P$^{3}$-WAM。我们介绍P$^{3}$-WAM，这是一个面向自我中心灵巧操作的统一世界动作模型，通过三种互补模式学习3D感知、动作条件预测和目标导向规划：Perceive（感知）模式从视频重建关节式手部运动和相机轨迹；Predict（预测）模式在给定动作下生成视觉未来；Plan（规划）模式以初始图像、语言指令和可选的视觉目标为条件，联合生成动作轨迹及其预期的视觉结果。 我们的模型通过混合Transformer架构，将紧凑的结构化3D动作表示集成到预训练视频扩散Transformer中，该架构具有共享的基础权重、模态特定的适配以及双向的视觉-动作注意力。 随机化的模态可见性使视频和3D动作可以在三种模式中 either 作为条件上下文 or 作为预测目标。 实验表明，统一训练在所有三种能力上都优于单模式训练，包括在视觉-语言模型评估下的规划质量提升。 通过统一训练，我们的模型在四个数据集上的3D手部重建和动作条件视频预测任务中优于专门的基线方法，同时生成的目标导向操作视频在指令遵循和动作推进方面优于视频生成基线。 项目主页：https://p3-wam.pages.dev/
